Flusspferd.et: From Fluss (“river”) + Pferd (“horse”). Calque of Ancient Greek ἱπποπόταμος (hippopótamos).

Fluss.et:
From Middle High German vluȥ, from Old High German fluȥ, from Proto-West Germanic *fluti, from Proto-Germanic *flutiz, ultimately from the same root of fließen (“to flow”).
Not cognate with Latin fluvius, which derives instead from Proto-Indo-European *bʰlewH-…
